name: Employment Hero / KeyPay - Super Contributions (payments)
notes: The payments CSV carries a Status column at the far right. Beam statuses run Created, Submission accepted, Awaiting payment, Awaiting clearance, Sent to fund, Reconciled. None of them is a fund receipt date. The first three mean the money has not left the employer -- a batch merely created, submitted, or still waiting on the employer's payment -- so those rows get no remitted date. A status outside the ladder is refused rather than guessed.
